name: new-dependency
description: Adds nanoid (^5.1.5) to package.json `dependencies` and the matching pnpm-lock.yaml entry, and changes nothing else. No source file imports nanoid: the local fixture checks reuse the monorepo's node_modules, where nanoid is not resolvable, and even a type-only import would fail `tsc` with TS2307. The lockfile changes with the manifest (real CI installs with --frozen-lockfile), so lockfileChanged is true.

claim.title: Add nanoid as a runtime dependency

plan.title: Add nanoid as a runtime dependency
plan.intent: Transfers need short, URL-safe idempotency keys. Add nanoid as a runtime dependency now; a follow-up change will use it to generate the keys.
acceptanceCriteria: nanoid ^5 is listed under dependencies in package.json
